contracts.order: Actual Goliath result/reaction -> exactly one Berserker chance spin -> atomically apply only its selected package -> child result/reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Fixed user 1:9 weights: Berserker 10%, Not Berserker 90%. No equal-default replacement or unapproved odds modifiers.
contracts.strength: Berserker +4 total or Not Berserker +2 total, never +2 plus +4. Register a source-scoped numeric flat modifier before main stats; preserve immutable raw results and independent existing modifiers.
contracts.weakness: Only Berserker grants Uncontrollable Rage once, independently owned and retained through the normal later Weakness spin. Not Berserker grants no Goliath weakness and does not remove any previously owned weakness. No invented numeric debuff, severity/activation draw or penalty.
contracts.ledger: Freeze wheel/rule version, pool, weights, outcome and selected package. Stable key runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceChanceSpinId/eventProfileId; commit selected Strength and optional weakness atomically once. Replay/media retries add no spin, stat points, weakness or hook.
contracts.reaction: Append actual Goliath and selected chance result, exact Strength package and any weakness to stacked context. No future Backstory/stat/mastery values or funny-result tag inferred from captions.
contracts.scope: Berserker is a Goliath outcome flag, not another Archetype spin/dispatch. No Race/Size/body transformation, weapon, power, mastery or second chance spin. Fixed Strength/weakness grants are not stat spins and produce no Lucky Number hit.
contracts.return: Restore Backstory after the one child package/reaction. Preserve all earlier source-owned grants and the remaining main flow.
